output.title: Opt-in ingress-shim annotation option not configured here
output.content: The change adds an optional ingress-shim option, --extra-certificate-annotations, that only copies annotations when set. The environment summary shows no values key for it and its manifests contain only apps/v1 Deployment and cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate, with no Ingress-like resources. Nothing shown here would exercise the new option.
